research_snapshot.reported_mechanism: Use Keepa /deal for enumerable Amazon price-change/deal candidates; Amazon Creators/approved data path for ASIN offer confirmation where permitted. Generic site crawl is not an equivalent.
research_snapshot.reported_extraction: ASIN, offer merchant Amazon.com, Buy Box, condition, shipping/Prime, coupon vs sale; Keepa price-history state and current state separated.
research_snapshot.known_risks: A generic ASIN represents multiple sellers and conditions; avoid claiming price is sold by Amazon without offer verification.

history.note: Research only; no fresh live source run, authorization, adapter validation or independent review implied.
